questions.stem: Which value is not required to measure creatinine Clearance?

options.label: C
options.text: Volume of Serum passing through kidney in 24 hour

questions.answerText: Volume of Serum passing through kidney in 24 hour

The volume of plasma passing through the kidney in 24 hours is not used in the calculation of creatinine clearance.

questions.stem: A 65 year male patient visited the ER for pain and his BP was measured as SBP 190mm Hg, DBP 100mm Hg. Pulse pressure 90mm Hg. Which of the following parameter that should decrease for this high pulse pressure:
questions.solutionHtml:
Arterial wall Compliance
  • Pulse pressure increases with age due to decreased arterial wall compliance.
  • With advancing age, there is an increase in systolic blood pressure. Whilst diastolic blood pressure falls after 60 years of age due to increased arterial stiffness (decreased compliance). As a result of these two changes, pulse pressure increases .

questions.stem: In physiology viva, examiner asked to student "who recorded first human EEG?" student responded "I don't know ". Examiner felt bad and decided to given him a hint, "the name rhymes with what you get at MC Donald's" Then the student gave the right answer. Here the student uses which type of memory:
questions.solutionHtml:
Priming

The correct option is Priming because the hint (rhymes with what you get at McDonald's) unconsciously influences the student's response, leading them to recall the answer without conscious awareness.

questions.stemHtml: The graph below shows the normal rate of synthesis of the various hemoglobin chains in utero, and after birth. Gamma chain of hemoglobin is indicated by which of the following?
questions.solutionHtml:
B

In the given image, the Orange curve represents the gamma-globin chain production. Gamma globin chain is produced in the fetal period and drops to undetectable levels 6 months postpartum which is the pattern represented by the Orange curve.

  • Alpha chain - Red curve
  • Beta chain - Green curve
  • Epsilon chain - Black curve
  • Delta chain - Blue curve

questions.stem: Gibbs - Donnan equilibrium is mainly by:
questions.solutionHtml:

The correct answer is Protein because the presence of negatively charged proteins inside the cell or blood vessel is a significant factor in establishing the Gibbs-Donnan equilibrium.

questions.stem: Calculate ECF volume from the following. 10gm mannitol injection given in venous blood. At equilibrium, urinary excretion 10% and plasma concentration of mannitol is 65mg/100ml:
questions.solutionHtml:
14L
  • The amount of mannitol injected is 10gm. The amount of mannitol excreted is 10% which comes to be 1 gm. So the leftover mannitol in the body is 9gms.
  • Plasma concentration at equilibrium is 65mg/100ml.
  • That means 100ml of ECF, contains 65mg of mannitol. Therefore, 9gm of mannitol would have around (9gm x 100ml)/65mg.
  • On calculating, it comes around 14Litres (13.8 litres).


Costanzo Physiology- 6th Edition Page no 250.

questions.stem: In negative feedback, feedback gain is infinity in which of the following :-

options.label: D
options.text: No such infinite feedback gain is not possible

questions.solutionHtml:
Blood volume control by kidney
  • In negative feedback, feedback gain of infinity could be seen in blood volume control by the kidney.
  • When the blood volume falls below the equilibrium, the renal-body fluid mechanism causes the blood volume to return back to the equilibrium point resulting in zero error and hence the gain of kidney in its ability to regulate blood volume is infinity (∞).


Guyton and Hall Textbook of Medical Physiology, 13th Edition Page nos 8 and 228.

questions.stem: In skeletal muscle DHPR and RYR receptors are coupled by:
questions.solutionHtml:
Mechanically

The correct coupling between DHPR and RYR in skeletal muscle is mechanical, involving a physical interaction between the two receptors, and not chemical or electric in nature.
